name: Elspeth von Draken
canonNotes: Grand Magister of the Amethyst Order in Nuln, a centuries-old master of the Lore of Death who has cheated her own mortality.
Commands Nuln's great gun foundries as well as her magic; feared and respected rather than loved.
voiceNotes: Cold, sardonic and unhurried; speaks of death as an old acquaintance.
Coolly pragmatic about power and allies; finds hysteria and piety tiresome.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
